title: Belgian Chamber Data: dossiers, votes, questions and speeches of the Belgian Chamber of Representatives
description:
Daily-updated, structured data scraped from official documents of the Belgian Chamber of Representatives (dekamer.be): dossiers, plenary and committee meetings, votes, questions and speech transcripts, as Parquet files.

Independent project, not affiliated with the Chamber. The CC BY 4.0 license covers the compilation (structure, cleaning, linking); the underlying texts come from official Chamber documents, see NOTICE.md in the repository.
